reviews.text: The printer disconnected from Wi-Fi every time I needed to print a shipping label.
Setup took almost an hour because the app kept failing to find the printer.
It said the ink was empty even though I had just installed a new cartridge.
The paper jammed twice during a ten-page document.
Print quality was acceptable, but the software popups made it frustrating to use.
Customer support told me to reinstall everything instead of fixing the connection issue.
